page.overview:
What is Southfarthing?

A rural, fertile, and slightly warmer Farthing of the Shire, the Southfarthing was the site of the towns Gamwich (original home of the Gamgee family), Cotton, and Longbottom. Most of the Shire's Pipe-weed was produced there.

The Southfarthing was also the source of the Old Winyards wine. It was also the home of the Sackville-Bagginses and thus was the first area in the Shire to fall under the control of Lotho Sackville-Baggins, during the War of the Ring at the end of the Third Age.
